explication: YSAP is a programming-education content repository: the creator authors episodes, demonstrations, and supporting tools; website scripts assemble that material into pages; visitors consume the resulting site or episode list from a terminal. Patreon utilities form a separate CSV-to-terminal workflow. Sampled demonstrations show independent Unix, HTTP, inode, terminal, and door-program behavior rather than one application pipeline. The tree supports the major repository areas, but unsampled website-script internals are represented only where their documented purpose is clear.
